	is_special = yes
	category = army_light_cavalry
	copy_from = a_age_3_discovery_light_cavalry
	upgrades_to = a_pistoleers
	buildable = yes

	# Base cavalry: max_strength=0.6, combat_power=2.6
	# Camel lancers: hurling spears from camelback before charging.
	# Signature: desert mobility, the same +1 vanilla gives its own Tuareg
	# veiled cavalry, and the javelin volley that opens the fight
	# (initiative, that unit's own +3). Flanking and shock sit at the best
	# of vanilla's age 3 light cavalry (akinji 0.2, camelry 0.05).
	# Weakness: Tuareg riders wore robes and carried a hide shield, no body
	# armour, so they bleed when a formed line holds against them.
	morale_damage_done = 0.12
	flanking_ability = 0.41

REPLACE:a_nd_can_mounted_police = {
	is_special = yes
	category = army_light_cavalry
	copy_from = a_age_6_revolutions_light_cavalry
	buildable = yes

	# Deltas on a_age_6_revolutions_light_cavalry (strength 1.2). The force
	# that made the March West of 1874 (275 men over 1,300 km): it travels
	# far and loses little on the way, and it is a constabulary of a few
	# hundred, so a regiment is a sixth smaller than line cavalry.
	# attrition_loss -0.25 cancels the cavalry category's extra attrition,
	# the same number vanilla gives a_gurkha.
	# With a sixth of the men gone the unit fought worse than the cavalry it
	# copies (total combat power 3.669 against 4.194). What a picked
	# constabulary has is steadiness: it does not break and it breaks
	# others. Morale damage taken -0.1 and done +0.1 put it at 4.271.
	max_strength = -0.2
	movement_speed = 0.15
	attrition_loss = -0.425
	morale_damage_done = 0.1
	morale_damage_taken = -0.1

	country_potential = {
		has_or_had_tag = CAN
	}

	gfx_tags = { medium_tag }
}

REPLACE:a_nd_can_voltigeurs = {
	is_special = yes
	category = army_light_infantry
	copy_from = a_age_5_absolutism_light_infantry
	upgrades_to = a_sharpshooters
	buildable = yes

	# Deltas on a_age_5_absolutism_light_infantry (strength 2.5). The corps
	# was one provincial battalion of a few hundred volunteers, so a regiment
	# is a sixth smaller than a line one: that is what the skirmishing costs.
	# Initiative 3 is vanilla's top step for light foot (a_late_longbowmen);
	# the morale damage is Chateauguay, where bugles sounded from the woods
	# made 300 men pass for an army.
	max_strength = -0.4
	initiative = 3.35
	morale_damage_done = 0.1
	strength_damage_taken = -0.05
	combat = {
		forest = 0.15
	}

	country_potential = {
		has_or_had_tag = CAN
	}

	gfx_tags = { medium_tag }
}

	category = army_light_cavalry
	copy_from = a_age_4_reformation_light_cavalry
	upgrades_to = a_hussars
	buildable = yes

	# Speed, morale shock and initiative are vanilla's own camelry values
	# (a_light_camelry_4, 3_camel_units.txt:172: 0.2, 0.05 and 5). The
	# initiative was missing, which left the unit below its own template in
	# total combat power (2.443 against 2.452) and well below the vanilla
	# camelry the same country can build.
	movement_speed = 0.76
	morale_damage_done = 0.05
	initiative = 5
	# Shutarnal: the swivel gun fired from the camel's saddle.
	strength_damage_done = 0.05

	category = navy_heavy_ship
	copy_from = n_age_5_absolutism_heavy_ship
	upgrades_to = n_threedecker
	buildable = yes

	# Lighter, faster frigate: fewer guns but better speed. Stats are deltas
	# on the template. The crew saving is the largest vanilla gives any ship
	# (n_italian_galleass, -0.03) and the speed the largest it gives a heavy
	# ship (n_early_iberian_galleon, 0.5); the comment promised speed and
	# fewer guns and the block wrote neither until 2026-10-02.
	movement_speed = 0.5
	cannons = -10
	crew_size = -0.114

	country_potential = {
		has_or_had_tag = TWS
	}

	gfx_tags = { heavy_tag }
}

REPLACE:n_nd_ukr_war_chaika = {
	is_special = yes
	category = navy_galley
	# Its levy unlocks in age 3 (nd_ukr_black_sea_raids), so it copies the
	# age 3 galley, like the chaika players build.
	copy_from = n_age_3_discovery_galley
	buildable = no
	levy = yes

	# Base age 3 galley: speed=4, hull=8, cannons=12, crew=0.075, blockade=0.3
	# The same boat as the chaika: fast, with a small crew. The reed
	# bundles lashed along the gunwales kept a holed boat afloat (hull), and
	# it carried a handful of falconets where a galley carried guns.
	movement_speed = 2
	hull_size = 1
	cannons = -2
	crew_size = -0.0185

	country_potential = {
		has_or_had_tag = UKR
	}

	gfx_tags = { eastern_galley }
}
